subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Plants growing in groups can show up to 43% greater resistance to drought than those growing individually.
• The mechanisms behind this cooperative survival benefit hadn't been fully explored.
• Botanist Makda Fantahun used greenhouse experiments to study the effects of shared root networks.
• The study revealed that plants exchange water and nutrients through interconnected root systems.
• Fantahun determined this sharing increases individual plant survival rates by 67% during water stress.
prompt: The student wants to present the study and its methodology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: A study revealed that plants, which show up to 43% greater drought resistance when growing in groups, also experience 67% higher survival rates during water stress.
choices.B: Makda Fantahun studied the mechanisms behind the fact that by sharing water and nutrients through root systems, plants improve their survival.
choices.C: Seeking to understand how plants growing in groups achieve greater drought resistance, Makda Fantahun used greenhouse experiments to study the effects of shared root networks.
choices.D: Botanist Makda Fantahun discovered that plants exchange water and nutrients through interconnected root systems, increasing survival rates by 67% during water stress.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence presents both the study and its methodology (that is, the researcher's approach to the problem), explaining that Fantahun used greenhouse experiments to study the effects of shared root networks on plants' drought resistance.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. While the sentence provides general information about Fantahun's study, it doesn't present the study's methodology.
